entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The prayer made in the instant petition is for a direction to the respondents to award and grant
compensation to the petitioner in terms of letter dated 03.06.2024 within stipulated period of time.
2.  The facts in brief are that the respondents issued notification under Section 3-A on 17.08.2022 under the National Highways Act, 1956 for acquisition of certain land.

It included the land of Araji No. 2008 area 1.1890 hectare which according to the petitioner belongs to him having been purchased by sale deed dated 21.04.1981 from the recorded tenure holder Smt. Premwati.

It was Aditya Sharan Gupta vs State Of U.P. And Another on 5 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/58046224/
1 followed by notification under Section 3-D dated 17.12.2022 and an award dated 06.07.2023.

entities.text: Aditya Sharan Gupta vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The petitioner was informed by the Competent Authority by letter dated 03.06.2024 that sum of Rs.4,65,79,784.00 has been determined as compensation for the subject land.
Since the compensation amount has not been released in favour of the petitioner and therefore, the petitioner has filed the instant petition.

3. Learned standing counsel has placed on record the instructions received by him from the Competent Authority, according to which, the compensation amount has not been released so far in view of pendency of Original Suit No. 611 of 2024, (Sumitra @ Nanki vs. Anil Kumar and others) in the court of Civil Judge (Junior Division), Kanpur Nagar.

entities.text: Sumitra @ Nanki vs. Anil Kumar and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: court of Civil Judge (Junior Division), Kanpur Nagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 4. The petitioner has filed a supplementary affidavit annexing therewith copy of the plaint to demonstrate that the said suit is wholly frivolous and abuse of the process of the Court.
Thereby, the plaintiffs have sought cancellation of sale-deed executed in favour of the petitioner on 26.06.1981 i.e.almost after forty years.
He submits that the petitioner has already filed an application under Order 7 Rule XII of CPC for rejection of the plaint and the same is pending.
He submits that the Competent Authority in any view of the matter should consider the issue relating to release of compensation as per provisions of Section 3H(3) and 3H(4) of the Act.
5. Shri Rajiv Gupta, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel also makes the same submission.

6. In our opinion, the Competent Authority has to examine the issue in the light of Sections 3H(3)
and 3H(4) of the Act.

7. Accordingly, we dispose of the instant petition with direction to the Competent Authority to pass a speaking order after hearing the petitioner and the newly impleaded respondent i.e. Sumitra Devi or any other person claiming any right in the subject land for the compensation awarded within a period of twelve weeks from the date of communication of the instant order along with a fresh representation.

Mukesh Kr.
(Anish Kumar Gupta,J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.)
